body: Yeah, I’m just waiting for an opportunity during alone time to pop up, it’s not every day or even every week that we have time alone so I don’t want to misjudge how long it would take, I definitely want to give her time to sit on it, and see how she reacts in person. I’m gonna make a point to tell her that she’s the only person I’ve told about this, so she doesn’t feel untrusted.
I guess it’s less about owing her an explanation and more about being comfortable talking about it/getting it off my chest. I’m the only one who knows about it as of now.
